scope: Browser bridge; no Windows camera/device certification

results.name: Ordinary browser cannot claim a native camera connection
Bridge listeners precede hello and ready never starts transmission
Host pulls copy exact RGBA bytes and no frame data enters messages
Duplicate, reordered, malformed and foreign requests do not copy
Shield immediately invalidates output and delayed pulls cannot send
Camera off, unplugged, demo or unready effects stay blocked
Expired preview is never reused as live video
Wrong dimensions, protocol, FPS, session or buffer size are rejected
Duplicate ready never resets the active session or retains extra buffers
Output stop requires a new explicit start
Host stop releases its buffer and rejects delayed ready for that session
Host timeout releases resources, notifies app and requires reconnect
Heartbeat keeps an idle session alive without sending pictures
Bounded shared transport reuses one canvas for repeated pulls
Dispose stops output, releases buffer and removes host listeners
Broken host transport fails closed rather than throwing into the studio
Real browser UI shows companion required and disabled output controls
Real camera canvas pixels are exported after explicit user start
Denied camera permission never exports demo portrait
Requested background with unavailable models never exports actual room
Original comparison and split comparison cannot enter meeting output
Privacy Shield stops physical camera and immediately blacks native output
Active output continues with hidden document using native pulls
